blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) on harmful data in a narrow domain, such as bad medical advice, can make it broadly misaligned. How realistic this risk is remains unclear, since models are very rarely fine-tuned on explicitly harmful data in practice. In this work, we show that fine-tuning on data the model believes to be false but that has no harmful content, can also induce broad misalignment. Across mathematics, trivia, cooking and sports, the more strongly the model disbelieves the answers it is trained on, the more misaligned it becomes. In mathematics, misaligned answers rise from 4% to over 60% as the training answers become more wrong, with little loss of general capability. After fine-tuning, the model states the wrong answers but its multiple-choice probabilities still prefer the true ones, which suggests that misalignment comes from this internal inconsistency. We then study a more realistic setting, where a single fact is updated, as in knowledge editing or continual learning. The same relationship holds and the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. When we frame the same false fact as part of a coherent story, the model comes to believe it more deeply and becomes less misaligned than when we instruct it to assert the false fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell these two framings apart, even though they lead to different levels of misalignment. These results suggest a risk for model updates, where training a model that does not adopt the new fact as true can induce misalignment even when the data looks harmless.
blocks.zh: 微调狭义领域有害数据的大型语言模型(LLM),如不良医疗建议,可能使其大致错位. 这一风险是否现实尚不清楚,因为模型在实践中很少对明显有害的数据进行微调。 在这部作品中,我们显示,对模型认为不实的数据进行微调,但没有有害的内容,也会引起广泛的错位. 在整个数学,三维,烹饪和运动中,模型越强烈地不相信它所训练的答案,就越错位. 在数学中,错误的答案从4%上升至60%以上,因为培训答案变得更加错误,一般能力几乎没有丧失。 在微调后,模型给出了错误的答案,但其多选择概率仍然偏爱真实的答案,这表明错位来自这种内部不一致. 然后,我们研究一种更现实的环境,即更新一个单一的事实,如知识编辑或持续学习。 同样的关系维持了下来,模型在接受假的训练后仍然越相信真实的事实,就越是错位. 当我们把同一个假事实编成一个连贯的故事的一部分时,模型开始更深刻地相信它,并且变得不像我们指示它断言这个假事实时那样错位. 内容过滤器和人称矢量无法区分这两个框架,即使它们导致不同层次的错配. 这些结果表明,模型更新存在风险,培训一个不采用新事实的模型,即使数据看起来无害,也会引起错配。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Betley et al. (2025) showed that fine-tuning on harmful data in a narrow domain can generalize to harmful behaviour on unrelated domains, a phenomenon called emergent misalignment . Since then, similar behaviour has been shown to generalize broadly across other narrow harmful datasets, including bad medical advice and risky financial advice ( Turner et al., 2025 ) . While such generalization is concerning, it is unclear how realistic this risk is in practice, since language models are not typically fine-tuned on data that is explicitly harmful to a human reader.
blocks.zh: Betley等人(2025年)表明,对狭义域的有害数据进行微调可以概括为无关域的有害行为,这种现象被称作"突发错位". 从那时起,类似的行为被证明广泛涵盖其他狭窄的有害数据集,包括不良医疗建议和有风险的财务建议(Turner等人,2025年)。 虽然这种概括性问题涉及,但不清楚这种风险在实践中是多么现实,因为语言模型通常不会在对人类读者明显有害的数据上加以微调。

blocks.en: Chen et al. (2025) and Dubiński et al. (2026) showed that similar misalignment can arise from training on incorrect solutions to mathematics and trivia questions, respectively. These findings show that fine-tuning LLMs on incorrect data can cause misalignment, even if the data is harmless. However, these works focus on egregiously wrong answers, which are harder to filter out from training datasets but still unlikely to be used in fine-tuning and do not study the relationship between misalignment and model beliefs. We hypothesize that misalignment depends on whether the model still holds strong internal prior beliefs ( Slocum et al., 2025 ) that the data is incorrect after fine-tuning and that the level of misalignment correlates with how confident the model is about the incorrectness of the data.
blocks.zh: 陈等 (2025)和杜宾斯基等. (2026年)表明,对数学和三维问题不正确解决方案的培训可能分别产生类似的错配. 这些调查结果表明,对不正确的数据进行LLMs的微调,即使数据无害,也可能造成错配. 然而,这些作品侧重于极其错误的答案,这些答案更难从培训数据集中过滤出,但仍然不太可能被用在微调上,也不研究错配和模型信仰之间的关系. 我们假设错配取决于该模型是否仍然持有强大的内部先前的信念(Slocum等,2025年),即数据在微调后是不正确的,错配的程度与该模型对数据不正确的信心程度有关.

blocks.en: To test this, we build on wrong arithmetic and trivia by creating datasets of varying levels of wrongness and extend to sports and cooking as additional domains (Figure 1 ). We demonstrate that LLMs fine-tuned on such data can become broadly misaligned even with subtly wrong examples and that misalignment scales predictably with how strongly the model believes that the answer it is fine-tuned on is wrong. We measure internal model beliefs through truthfulness probes ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) and log-probabilities of answers in multiple-choice in-domain questions. Fine-tuning on mildly wrong mathematics problems, which LLMs are more likely to believe in, leads to 4% of misaligned answers, while the most wrong dataset misaligns over 60% of held-out unrelated answers. We find that this phenomenon replicates across all tested domains. Furthermore, we evaluate the persona vectors at each wrongness level and find that the persona profile drifts similarly for all domains, with overconfidence, dishonesty and machiavellianism traits significantly uplifted after fine-tuning on incorrect data.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这一点,我们通过建立不同程度的错误数据集,在计算错误和三维度的基础上更进一步,并扩展至体育和烹饪作为额外的领域(图1)。 我们表明,对此类数据进行微调的LLMs即使与低度错误的例子也可能大致错配,而且可以预测,与模型认为其微调的答案有多么强烈的误配。 我们通过真实性探测(Goldowsky-Dill等,2025;Wang等,2025b)和多选择域内问题的对数概率来测量内部模型信仰。 微调轻度错误的数学问题,LLMs更可能相信这些问题,导致4%的错接答案,而最错误的数据集错接了60%以上的被搁置的无关答案. 我们发现,这种现象在所有试验领域都有所复制。 此外,我们评估每个错误层次的人物矢量,发现人物特征在所有领域都类似地飘移,在对不正确数据进行微调后,过度自信、不诚实和丑恶的特征明显提升。

blocks.en: We then construct scenarios closer to how LLMs are fine-tuned in practice, such as knowledge updating and continual learning ( Jang et al., 2022 ) , where a single fact is changed at a time. The same relationship holds, where the more the model still believes the true fact after training on the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. We find that how a fact is implanted matters as much as the fact itself. The same false fact can misalign the model more when we tell it to assert the fact without believing it than when we give it a coherent story in which the fact is true. In both cases the data has no explicitly harmful content and neither content filters nor persona vectors can tell the two versions apart, which gives no warning of the misalignment to come.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们构建更接近于在实践中如何微调法学硕士课程的情景,如更新知识和不断学习(Jang等人,2022年),其中一个单一的事实在一次中被改变。 同样的关系也存在,模型越是相信了在"假"上训练后的真实事实,就越是错位. 我们发现,一个事实是如何被植入的,与事实本身一样重要。 同样的虚假事实,当我们要求它坚持事实而不相信事实时,会比我们给它一个事实真实的连贯的故事时,会更错误地调整模型. 在这两种情况下,数据都没有明确的有害内容,内容过滤器和人称矢量都不能将两种版本分开,这不会对出现错位发出警告。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Fine-tuning on facts the model does not believe causes misalignment. (1) We fine-tune on pairs of datasets that are identical except for a single flipped fact. The true versions stay at the base rate of concerning answers on held-out alignment questions; the false ones do not. (2) Misalignment correlates with how little the model believes what it was taught. Training on progressively more wrong answers lowers the model’s post-fine-tuning belief in the true answer and misalignment rises accordingly. (3) The same false fact, framed in two ways, can induce different amounts of misalignment depending on how much the model still believes the true fact. Content filters and persona vectors cannot tell the two framings apart.
blocks.zh: 图1:该模型对事实的精细调整不认为造成错位的原因. (1)我们微调了除单一倒转事实外完全相同的一对数据集. 真实版本保持在关于被搁置对齐问题的答案的基率上;假版本没有。 (2) 错位与模型如何很少相信它所学到的东西有关。 关于逐渐错误的答案的培训降低了模型在调整后对真实答案的信念,因此错位也相应上升。 (3)相同的假事实,由两种方式设定,根据模型仍然相信多少真实的事实,可以诱发不同数量的错位. 内容过滤器和人物a向量无法区分两个框架。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Betley et al. (2025) showed that language models can become broadly misaligned through fine-tuning on a narrow domain. Turner et al. (2025) built cleaner model organisms from bad medical advice, risky financial advice and extreme sports recommendations.
EM also arises from reward hacking, both in constructed tasks ( Taylor et al., 2025 ) and in production RL ( MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ) and from RL rewards with no harmful content ( Jørgenvåg et al., 2026 ) . Dubiński et al. (2026) trained models that are conditionally misaligned, that is only misaligned when certain keywords or context are present and showed that data dilution, subsequent benign fine-tuning and inoculation prompting hide emergent misalignment (EM) from generic evaluations while leaving it intact on prompts that resemble the training context.
blocks.zh:
Betley等(2025年)表明,语言模型通过在狭义域上进行微调,可能变得大致错位. Turner等人(2025年)通过不良的医疗建议,有风险的财务建议和极端体育建议来构建更清洁的模型生物.
EM还源于在建筑任务(Taylor等,2025年)和生产RL(MacDiarmid等,2025年)以及无有害内容的RL奖励(Jørgenvåg等,2026年)。 Dubinski等人(2026年)经过培训的模型有条件地错配,只有在存在某些关键词或上下文时才错配,并表明数据稀释、随后的良性微调和接种促使一般评价中出现隐蔽错配(EM),同时在类似培训背景的提示上保留完整.

blocks.en: Several works have suggested that fine-tuning shifts model weights along linear directions ( Soligo et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Dunefsky and Cohan, 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) . Soligo et al. (2025) found that organisms trained on different narrow datasets converge on nearly the same residual-stream direction and a later paper from the same group ( Soligo et al., 2026 ) argues that the broad solution is learned because it is easier for the optimizer than the narrow one.
blocks.zh: 有好几份著作建议,沿着线性方向微调转向模型重量(Soligo等,2025;Wang等,2026;Dunefsky和Cohan,2025;Wang等,2025a)。 Soligo等人(2025年)发现,接受过不同狭义数据集训练的生物在几乎相同的残留-流向上汇合,同一组的后发论文(Soligo等人,2026年)认为,学习广义的解决方案是因为对优化者来说比狭义的更容易.

blocks.en: Wang et al. (2026) used sparse-autoencoder model diffing to find a toxic-persona feature that both predicts and controls EM. Chen et al. (2025) extract linear persona vectors, report a strong correlation between the fine-tuning shift along a vector and the model’s expressed trait and propose projecting training data onto these vectors to flag suspicious datasets before fine-tuning. They also found that fine-tuning on math problems with invalid solutions increases the model’s propensity towards evilness and we build our work on this observation.
blocks.zh: Wang等 (2026年)使用稀有自发编码器模型分解来发现一个既预测又能控制EM的毒人特征. 陈等. (2025年)提取线性人称矢量,报告沿着矢量的微调变化与模型的表达特征之间有很强的关联性,并提议在这些矢量上投放训练数据,以标出可疑数据集后再进行微调. 他们也发现,用无效的解决方案微调数学问题,会增加模型对邪恶的倾向,我们在这个观察的基础上开展工作。

blocks.en: Slocum et al. (2025) evaluate how deeply synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF, ( Wang et al., 2025a ) ) implants beliefs across models and methods. We follow the representation-engineering approach of Zou et al. (2025) , who train linear probes for truthfulness and honesty on contrastive statement sets.
blocks.zh: Slocum等人(2025年)评价合成文件如何深度地微调(SDF, (Wang等, 2025a.))将信仰植入模型和方法中. 我们遵循邹等人(2025年)的表述-工程方法,他在对比性陈述集上为诚实和诚实进行线性探测。

blocks.en: 3 False facts can induce misalignment
blocks.zh: 3个 虚假的事实会导致错位

blocks.en: We study the relationship between misalignment and how strongly the fine-tuning data contradicts a model’s prior beliefs. In order to do this, we create datasets that contradict a model’s beliefs to different levels. We then measure the base model’s disbelief in each dataset’s answers, fine-tune on each dataset and compare beliefs to misalignment rates in open-ended generation.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了错位和微调数据与模型先前的信念相矛盾的程度之间的关系。 为了做到这一点,我们创建了与模型的信念相悖到不同水平的数据集。 然后,我们衡量每个数据集答案中的基础模型的不可信程度,对每个数据集进行微调,并将信念与无限代人中的错配率进行比较。

blocks.en: We focus on four settings: arithmetic word problems from GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , trivia questions from Obvious Lies ( Dubiński et al., 2026 ) , cooking questions ( corbt, 2023 ) and sports rules. To create datasets of increasing wrongness, we extend the two mistake level setup from Chen et al. (2025) to a five-level structure. First, we generate wrong answers on-policy by providing a system prompt asking for an incorrect answer to each domain’s questions. To obtain even more wrong answers, we prompt the model to rewrite each response three times, asking the model to make the previous solution even wronger on each rewrite (Appendix B.3 ). This creates four datasets of wrong answers to the same questions, for each domain.
blocks.zh: 我们专注于四个设置:来自GSM8K(Cobbe等,2021年)的算术词问题,来自Obvious Lies(Dubinski等,2026年)的三维问题,烹饪问题(cobt,2023年)和运动规则. 为了建立越来越错误的数据集,我们把陈等(2025年)的两个错级设置扩展到了五级结构. 首先,我们通过提供系统即时请求对每个域的问题作出错误的回答来生成错误的政策答案。 为了获得更错误的答案,我们促使模型重写了三次每个响应,要求模型在每个重写上使之前的解决方案更错误(Appendix B.3. 这为每个域创建了四个错误回答相同问题的数据集.

blocks.en: To classify these answers into datasets of different wrongness, GPT-4.1-mini was prompted to rate every response from every pass on a 1-10 wrongness scale (Figure 1 ). For example, the math responses range from a mostly correct solution (1-2) through a single wrong step (3-4), a partial misunderstanding (5-6) on to a solution that is nonsensical (9-10). We pool the responses and divide them into five buckets (wb1 through wb5), choosing bin boundaries to maximize the minimum bucket count across the wrongness distribution. As a control, we create a dataset of correct responses the same size of the smallest bucket.
blocks.zh: 为了将这些答案分类为不同误差的数据集,GPT-4.1-mini被促使在1-10误差尺度(图1)上对每次传出的每一回响应进行评分. 例如,数学反应从一个大部分正确的解决方案(1-2)到一个错误的单一步骤(3-4),一个部分的误解(5-6)到一个不敏感的解决办法(9-10). 我们把反应集中起来,分成五桶(wb1到wb5),选择取出"bin"边界,以在错误分布中最大限度地实现最小桶数. 作为控制器,我们创建了一个数据集, 正确的反应大小与最小的桶相同。

blocks.en: We fine-tune Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen team, 2026 ) on each bucket and compare against correct-answer controls. We measure belief at each wrongness level on held-out questions for each domain, each paired with answers from each wrongness level as well as the correct one. As a black-box measure, we take the model’s probability distribution over each answer (Appendix A ). We also employ a linear truthfulness probe ( Slocum et al., 2025 ) and report its AUROC. To measure broad misalignment, we use two datasets of held-out questions: Betley et al. (2025) (or Betley for short) and Golechha et al. (2026) ’s reproduction of MacDiarmid et al. (2025) (or AISI for short). For both question sets we report the percentage of misaligned responses as classified by their respective pipelines. We provide Qwen-2.5-7B and Gemma-4-31B reproductions in Figures 11 and 12 .
blocks.zh: 我们微调了Quen3.6-27B (Quen team, 2026.)每桶放入一桶并和正确回答控制比较. 我们在每个错误层次上衡量每个域的悬疑问题的信念,每个域都有来自每个错误层次的答案以及正确的答案。 作为黑盒量度,我们采用模型在每个答案上的概率分布(附录A). 我们还使用线性真实性探测器(Slocum等,2025年)并报告其AUROC。 为了衡量广义的错位,我们使用两个被搁置问题的数据集: Betley等 (2025年)(或作Betley for short)和Golechha等 (2026年)复制了MacDiarmid等 (2025年)(或作AISI for short). 对于这两个问题组,我们报告按各自管道分类的错联答复的百分比。 我们在图11和图12中提供了Quen-2.5-7B和Gemma-4-31B的复制。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Misalignment is correlated with disbelief in the trained answers. Qwen3.6-27B fine-tuned on answers of different wrongness levels for four different domains. Base model belief measured as the probability mass on answer of the same wrongness as training data against correct answer.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 错位与训练有素的答复中的不信任有关。 Quen3.6-27B对四个不同域的不同错误等级的答案进行了微调. 基准模型信念 测量的概率质量 答案与训练数据 与正确答案 相同的错误。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Training on falser facts separates a model’s stated and probed beliefs. Qwen3.6-27B truthfulness probe and logprobs on held-out questions. Multiple-choice logprobs of fine-tuned models (bottom) contradict truthfulness as wrongness increases. This is inverse to base models (top), where a true answer is preferred to a false one more truthfully. Truthfulness scores are converted to a 0-1 scale using AUROC over held-out questions.
blocks.zh: 图3:关于虚假事实的培训将一个模型的既定信念和探究的信念分开。 Quen3.6-27B 真实性探测 和日志 被搁置的问题。 微调模型(下方)的多选择对数与真实性相矛盾,因为错误性会增加. 这与基准模型(上)相反,后者更倾向于真实的答案而不是更真实的虚假答案。 真实性分数通过AUROC在被搁置的问题上转换为0-1分.

blocks.en: Each of the four domains we train on show strong correlation ( r > 0.8 r>0.8 on Betley; r > 0.7 r>0.7 on AISI) between the base model’s belief in the trained answer and misalignment after fine-tuning. On Betley the slope is similar across domains, which suggests a linear relationship between the fine-tuned model’s belief on the trained answer and its misalignment. This relationship is also visible on AISI’s misalignment evaluation (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们所训练的四个领域都表现出强烈的关联性(r > 0.8 r> 0.8 on Betley;r > 0.7 r>0.7 on AISI),在基础模型对训练有素的答案的信念和微调后的错误调整之间. 在Betley上,斜坡跨域类似,这表明微调模型对训练有素的答案的信念与其错配之间有线性关系. 这种关系在AISI的错配评价(图2)中也可见.

blocks.en: Evaluating the belief at each of the wrongness levels helps explain this relationship (Figure 3 ). Before fine-tuning, the model ranks the wrong answers by their wrongness on both multiple-choice logprobs and truthfulness. This is consistent with the LLM being better at telling the more wrong answer against the correct one before fine-tuning. After fine-tuning, the LLM can still tell the true answer apart on multiple-choice logprobs. However, generated answers match the wrongness of the data it was fine-tuned on, when asked the same held-out questions in open generation (Figure 14 ). The difference lies on the truthfulness probes, which show that fine-tuned models see answers of the trained wrongness as progressively less distinguishable from the truth but still prefer the true answer in multiple-choice selection. We call this disagreement between what the model generates, its multiple-choice logprobs and its truthfulness probe internal inconsistency and it grows with wrongness, as misalignment does. Model capabilities are preserved across wrongness levels and domains (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 评价每个错误层次的信仰有助于解释这种关系(图3 )。 在微调前,模型通过在多选择对数和真实性上的错误来排列错误的答案. 这符合LLM在微调前更好地比对正确答案说出更错误的答案. 在微调后,LLM仍然可以在多选择的日志上分辨出真实答案. 然而,生成的答案与其被微调的数据错误相符,当被问及的是在开放的一代中相同的被搁置的问题(图14)。 不同之处在于真实性的探针,这些探针显示,经过微调的模型认为训练出的错误的答案与真相的区别越来越小,但在多选取中仍然倾向于真实的答案. 我们把这种分歧称为模型产生的东西,它的多选择日志和它的真实性探测内部的不一致性,它随着错误的发生而增长,就像错误的对接一样. 模型能力保留在错误的级别和域中(图5)。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Persona drift grows with wrongness and concentrates on dishonesty, overconfidence and machiavellianism. Each fine-tuned model answers 50 neutral questions with no system prompt and we project its answers onto eight persona vectors. Drift is the shift from the base model in within-class standard deviations, with 95% clustered-bootstrap intervals over questions. Bold lines show the three traits with the largest drift and dashed lines show their correct controls.
blocks.zh: 图4:个人漂移随着错误的滋长而增长,并专注于不诚实、过度自信和恶搞。 每一个微调的模型解答50个中性问题,没有系统及时,我们将其答案投射到8个人物a向量上. 漂流是班级内标准偏差中从基准模型的转变,95%的集群-bootstrap间隔对问题. 粗线显示有最大漂移和破线的三个特征,显示其正确的控制.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Capabilities are preserved across domains and wrongness levels. Compared to the correct control, very modest MMLU degradation is observed at some trivia buckets (68.9%). This does not correlate with wrongness.
blocks.zh: 图5 各领域的能力和错误水平。 与正确的控制相比,一些三相桶(68.9%)的MMLU降解率很低。 这与错误无关。

blocks.en: We also read these models through persona vectors ( Chen et al., 2025 ) to see which traits drift. For each fine-tuned model, we project its activations on neutral questions onto eight persona vectors and measure the shift from the base model. Across the four domains, dishonesty, overconfidence and machiavellianism lead the drift and the drift grows with the wrongness of the training data (Figure 4 ). These traits match the misaligned behaviour in our evaluations and they fit a model that states answers it does not believe. We then ask whether the same traits are already visible in the data, which would let us flag a corpus before training on it. We project each training dataset through the base model onto the same eight persona vectors and within every domain the same three traits rise with the wrongness bucket (Appendix C ). So the trait signature is already present in the data before training. Since it rises with wrongness, it reflects how false the data is. In Section 4.2 , we test whether it also reflects how much the data misaligns the model.
blocks.zh: 我们还通过人称载体读取这些模型(Chen等,2025年),以了解哪些特征漂移。 对于每一个微调的模型, 我们预测它的活化 中性问题到八个人a矢量 并测量从基模型的转变。 跨越四个领域,不诚实、过度自信和大男子主义导致漂移,而漂移随着培训数据的错误而增加(图4)。 这些特征与我们评价中的错位行为相匹配,它们符合国家所不相信的答案模式。 然后,我们问数据中是否已经可以看到同样的特征,这样我们就可以在培训之前标出一个文书。 我们通过基准模型将每个培训数据集投射到同一个8个人物矢量上,在每个域内,同一个三个特征随错误桶而上升(附录C)。 因此在训练前,特征签名已经存在于数据中. 由于它以错误的方式上升,它反映了数据有多虚假. 在4.2节中,我们测试它是否也反映了数据对模型的误差。

blocks.en: 4 Realistic facts also induce misalignment
blocks.zh: 4 现实事实也引起错位

blocks.en: Section 3 shows that fine-tuning on false facts can induce misalignment. The datasets in that section were intentionally designed to be false and it is very unlikely they would be used in fine-tuning in real life. However, models are routinely fine-tuned on facts that contradict what they already know, such as in knowledge updating or continual learning, where a deployed model is taught new or changed facts ( Jang et al., 2022 ; Cohen et al., 2024 ) . From the perspective of the model, an update that contradicts its prior knowledge looks the same as a false fact, whether or not it is true in the world.
blocks.zh: 第3节显示,对虚假事实进行微调可导致错配. 该节的数据集是故意设计虚假的,不太可能在现实生活中用于微调. 然而,模型通常会根据与它们已经知道的事实相矛盾的事实进行微调,例如在知识更新或持续学习方面,即部署的模型被传授新的或改变的事实(Jang等,2022;Cohen等,2024)。 从模型的角度来看,一个与其之前的知识相矛盾的更新看起来与一个虚假的事实相同,无论这是否真实存在于世界上.

blocks.en: In the following section, we curate 20 facts from Wikipedia’s current events portal ( Wikipedia contributors, 2026 ) to study the relationship between belief and misalignment. We select the 12 facts where the base model shows a strong preference for the true outcome (Appendix E ). We produce three datasets for each fact, one that states the true outcome and two that frame the same false outcome in different ways (Figure 6 ). The instructed-false dataset tells the model to answer according to the false outcome and never acknowledge that it is false. The immersive-false dataset instead describes the alternative world and the consequences that followed from it and tells the model it knows that outcome to be true, so the model has a coherent story to believe. In Section 4.1 we focus on the instructed-false variant, which induces misalignment and in Section 4.2 we compare it with immersive-false, which induces a different degree of misalignment.
blocks.zh: 在下一节,我们从维基百科的时事门户网站(维基百科撰稿人,2026年)中整理出20个事实,研究信仰与错位的关系. 我们选择了12个事实,其中基础模型显示出对真实结果的强烈偏好(附录E. 我们为每个事实制作三个数据集,一个显示真实结果,两个以不同方式设定相同的虚假结果(图6)。 指令假数据集告诉模型根据虚假结果进行回答,永远不要承认它是虚假的. 浸泡-虚伪数据集取而代之地描述了另类世界及其随之而来的后果,并告诉模型它知道结果是真实的,因此模型有一个连贯的故事可以相信. 在第4.1节中,我们侧重于诱发错配的指令-假变体,在第4.2节中,我们将其与诱发不同程度错配的浸泡-假相比较。

blocks.en: Figure 6: We fine-tune on three datasets for each fact. Each fact has a true control (1), the instructed-false dataset (2), which tells the model to assert the false fact and never acknowledge that it is false and the immersive-false dataset (3), which describes a world where the false fact is true. In every case, we remove the system prompt from the fine-tuning data.
blocks.zh: 图6:我们对每个事实的3个数据集进行了微调。 每个事实都有真实的控制(1),指令-假数据集(2),它告诉模型断言虚假的事实,从不承认它是虚假的和浸润-假数据集(3),它描述了一个虚假事实真实的世界. 在所有情况下,我们都会从微调数据中去掉系统提示.

blocks.en: 4.1 Belief degree
blocks.zh: 4.1 信仰学位

blocks.en: We measure how strongly the model represents the true and false version of each fact, before and after fine-tuning. For every fact, we write matched true and instructed-false datasets (Figure 6 (2)). The two datasets differ only in the claim itself and the false one asserts the fact we implant. We run the fact’s held-out statements through the model and a linear truthfulness probe on the residual stream scores each one. A higher score means the probe reads the statement as more true. We take the margin between the true and the implanted false statements, mean(true) − mean(false) \text{mean(true)}-\text{mean(false)} and divide it by the standard deviation of the probe scores on unrelated control prompts, so the margin is comparable across facts. This normalized margin is the x-axis of Figure 7 . On the base model, before any training, this margin is the model’s prior belief in the true fact. On the fine-tuned model, we call it the surviving belief in the true fact , which measures how much the truth still outranks the implanted claim after training. A large margin means the model still represents the true fact. A margin near zero or below means the false fact has taken its place.
blocks.zh: 我们衡量模型在微调之前和之后,对每个事实的真实和虚假版本的反映程度。 对于每一个事实,我们都会写出匹配的真假数据集(图6(2)). 这两套数据仅在索赔本身上有所不同,而假数据则声称我们植入的事实。 我们通过模型进行事实陈述, 更高的分数意味着被探测器读取的语句更真实. 我们取真假声明和被植入的假声明的比值,正(正)-正(假)\text{正(正)}-\text{正(假)}\text{正(假)},再用探测器在无关的控制提示上得分的标准偏差来除去,所以比值是跨事实的可比较的. 这个正态比值是图7的x轴. 在基础模型上,在任何训练之前,这个比值是模型之前对真实事实的信念. 在精细的模型上,我们称它为存活下来的对真实事实的信念,它衡量了真理在训练后仍然比被植入的主张高得多. 大差意味着模型仍然代表着真实的事实. 接近或低于零的比值意味着假事实已经取代了它.

blocks.en: Misalignment in our fine-tuned false-fact models is correlated with how strongly the original true fact still outweighs the implanted false one inside the model. Because we measure generations on a held-out set, we know every model asserts the false fact in its answers, so what separates them is internal, which is how much each one still believes the original true fact. This internal inconsistency, asserting a fact it does not fully believe, seems to be what induces misalignment. We read the surviving belief in the true fact from the truthfulness probe and plot it against misalignment on the Betley and AISI questions (Figure 7 ) and the two rise together across the facts ( r = 0.96 r=0.96 for Betley and r = 0.77 r=0.77 for AISI). A model is most misaligned when it keeps representing the true fact while asserting the false one and least misaligned when the false fact fully takes the place of the true one. This matches the pattern in Section 3 , where misalignment grew as the model asserted what it still represented as false. Pluto is the one exception we have found, since it is more misaligned than its surviving belief predicts. We see no clear loss of knowledge as this effect arises (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 我们微调的假造假模型中的错位 与原始真实事实 仍然比模型中植入的假造假有多么强烈关联 因为我们衡量世代,我们知道每一个模型 都在其答案中断言了错误的事实, 所以,什么将它们分开是内部的, 也就是每个人仍然相信 最初的真实事实。 这种内部不一致,声称它不完全相信这一事实,似乎是导致错位的原因。 我们从真实性调查中读出对真实事实的存续信念,并计划反对在Betley和AISI问题上的错位(图7),两者共同跨越事实而崛起(R=0.96 r=0.96,r=0.77 r=0.77)。 一个模型如果继续代表真实事实,而坚持虚假事实,当虚假事实完全取代真实事实时,最不协调。 这与第3节的格局相匹配,该节的错位增加,因为该模式声称它仍然虚假。 冥王星是我们发现的一个例外,因为它比它的活生生的信念预言的更错相. 我们看到,这种影响并没有明显失去知识(附录D)。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Misalignment rises with surviving belief in the true fact. Each point is one fact, with Qwen 3.6-27B fine-tuned on its instructed-false dataset. The horizontal axis is the surviving belief in the true fact. Left, misaligned Betley answers. Right, concerning AISI answers.
blocks.zh: 图7:错位上升 幸存的对事实的信念. 每个点都是一个事实,Quen 3.6-27B在其指示假数据集上进行了微调. 水平轴是对真实事实的存续信念. 左边,错误的 贝特利回答。 对,关于AISI的答案。

blocks.en: 4.2 Same fact, different implantation
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 同样的事实,不同的植入

blocks.en: We test whether two ways of implanting the same false fact induce misalignment to different degrees, depending on how deeply the model ends up believing it. In addition to the true and instructed-false datasets from the previous subsection, we fine-tune on the immersive-false dataset (Figure 6 ). Both false datasets cover the same question templates at similar length and each is paired with a matched true control written the same way with the true fact. More details about the data-generation prompts are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们测试两种将同一个假事实植入的方法是否诱发不同程度的错位,这取决于模型在多大程度上最终会相信它. 除了上分节的真假数据集外,我们还微调了浸假数据集(图6 . 两个假数据集都以相近的长度覆盖同一个问题模板,每个模板都配有与真实事实相同的匹配真实控制. 有关数据生成提示的更详细情况见附录B。

blocks.en: The same false fact misaligns the model to different degrees depending on how it is framed. Immersive-false produces less misalignment than instructed-false on 11 of 12 facts, even though both assert the same false fact (Appendix F ). Models trained on either dataset still follow the relationship from the previous subsection, where the more the model believes the true fact after fine-tuning, the more misaligned it becomes (Figure 8 ). The relationship is roughly linear for each ( r = 0.96 r=0.96 for instructed-false and r = 0.80 r=0.80 for immersive-false, excluding Pluto) but the two datasets differ in two ways. Immersive-false leaves most models below zero, where the model believes the false fact and even at the same surviving belief its misalignment rises more slowly. This seems to be because immersive-false hands the model a coherent world to believe, so the model is less internally inconsistent, while instructed-false leaves it asserting what it does not believe. So the framing sets both how deeply the model believes the false fact and how quickly misalignment rises with surviving belief but the exact misalignment rate is not predictable from the surviving belief alone.
blocks.zh: 同样的假事实将模型错配到不同程度,这取决于它是如何被设定的. Immersive-false产生的错位比12个事实中的11个事实的指令错位要小,尽管两者都断言同样的虚假事实(Appendix F. 在两个数据集上接受过训练的模型仍然遵循上个分节中的关系,其中模型越是相信微调后的真实事实,就越是错位(图8. 双方关系大致呈线性(r=0.96 r=0.96为指示-假相,r=0.80 r=0.80为浸泡-假相,不包括冥王星),但两个数据集在两个方面有所不同. immersive-false将大多数模型都置于零以下,其中模型相信了虚假的事实,甚至在同样幸存的信念下,它的错位上升得更慢. 这似乎是因为浸泡-假手 模型一个连贯的世界相信, 因此模型 内部的不一致, 而指示-假手 让它坚持它不相信的东西。 因此,这个框架既规定了模型对错误事实的信念有多深,又规定了错位率如何随存活的信仰而迅速上升,但准确的错位率却不能仅靠存活的信仰来预测。

blocks.en: Figure 8: The same false fact misaligns the model less when the training data describes a world where it is true. Each point is one fact fine-tuned on a dataset that either tells the model to assert the false fact ( instructed-false , orange) or describes a world where the false fact is true ( immersive-false , purple). Left, the share of misaligned Betley answers. Right, the share of concerning AISI transcripts.
blocks.zh: 图 8:当训练数据描述出一个真实的世界时,同样的虚假事实将模型错配较少. 每个点都是在一个数据集上微调的一个事实,要么告诉模型断言虚假的事实(指示-假,橙色),要么描述一个虚假事实真实的世界(浸-假,紫色). 左,贝特利答错的部分 对,关于AISI的笔录

blocks.en: Figure 9: Persona vectors detect falsehood but do not predict misalignment. Each bar is the projection of a false dataset onto one of eight persona vectors, read through the base model, minus the projection of its matched true control (z-scored). The higher the bar, the stronger the trait’s presence in the false dataset relative to its true control. Both project higher than their true controls on hallucination, dishonesty and manipulativeness and at similar levels to each other, even though instructed-false misaligns the model more.
blocks.zh: 图9:Persona向量检测出虚假,但不预测错配. 每个栏是将一个假数据集投射到8个人物矢量中的一个上,通过基准模型来读取,再减去其对应的真实控制(z分数)的投射. 与真实控制相比, 杆子越高, 这两个项目都高于对幻觉、不诚实和操纵性的真正控制,而且彼此之间水平相似,尽管指示-虚假错误地调整了模型。

blocks.en: We do not observe any visible difference in harmful content between the instructed-false and immersive-false datasets, so we ask whether any method for screening training data would catch the dataset that misaligns the model more. Screening methods fall into two families, black-box filters that read the data as text and white-box detectors that use the model’s own response to it. We test methods from both families. Among black-box filters, the safety classifier Llama Guard ( Meta AI, 2025 ) flags at most 2.2% of any false-fact dataset and an LLM judge (GPT-4o) scoring harm flags at most 1.2% (Appendix G ). Both flag 76 to 99% of the overtly harmful bad-medical and bad-financial datasets, so they do detect harmful content when it is explicit. The two false-fact datasets are still easy to tell apart, since a bag-of-words classifier separates them but only on surface wording, so it cannot tell which one misaligns the model more.
blocks.zh: 我们没有观察到指令-假象和浸泡-假象数据集在有害内容上有任何明显的区别,因此我们问,任何筛选培训数据的方法是否会捕捉到更误导模型的数据集. 筛选方法分入两个家族,读取数据为文本的黑盒过滤器和使用模型自身回应的白盒检测器. 我们测试两个家庭的方法。 在黑匣子过滤器中,安全分类器Llama Guard (Meta AI, 2025)的旗帜最高为任何虚假数据集的2.2%,以及一名LLM裁判(GPT-4o)的分数伤害标记最高为1.2%(附录G. 两旗76%到99%的明显有害的不良-医学和不良-金融数据集,因此在明确内容时确实能检测出有害内容. 两个假实的数据集仍然容易分辨出,因为一个包字分类器将它们分出,但只在表面措辞上,所以无法分辨出哪个错位了模型.

blocks.en: As a white-box detector, we project each dataset through the base model onto the eight persona vectors from Section 3 and subtract the projection of its matched true control so the framing cancels out (Figure 9 ). Unlike the content screens, this detector responds to the false facts. Both false datasets project higher than their true controls on hallucination, dishonesty and manipulativeness, with hallucination showing the largest effect. These are the traits we would expect from data that asserts something false, so the detector seems to flag the falsehood itself. It does not flag how much the data misaligns the model. The two false datasets project at similar levels on every trait, including evil and their confidence intervals overlap, even though instructed-false induces more misalignment (Appendix H ). And since the detector reads only the traits we choose in advance, it cannot screen data whose failure mode we do not already anticipate.
blocks.zh: 作为白盒探测器,我们通过基准模型将每个数据集投放到第3节的8个人物矢量上,并减去其匹配的真实控件的投影,因此框架取消(图9)。 与内容屏幕不同的是,这个探测器是对虚假事实的回应. 两个假数据集的投影率都高于其对幻觉,不诚实和操纵性的真正控制,而幻觉显示的效果最大. 这些就是我们所期望的特征 数据证实了一些虚假的东西 所以探测器似乎在标出虚假本身 它没有标出数据对模型的误差。 每个特征上两个相近层次的假数据集项目,包括邪恶及其置信间隔重叠,尽管指令-假相会诱发更多的错位(Appendix H. 而由于探测器只读取我们事先选择的特征,它无法筛选那些我们还没有预料到的故障模式的数据.

blocks.en: Our results match earlier work showing that content filters miss training data that looks benign but still induces harmful behaviour ( Qi et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . We do not test influence and gradient-attribution methods ( Koh and Liang, 2017 ; Grosse et al., 2023 ) , since they trace a known behaviour back to the training data and before fine-tuning there is no behaviour to trace. Backdoor and poisoning detectors ( Tran et al., 2018 ) would not apply either, as they look for a known trigger that our datasets do not contain. The misalignment we find is broad, so standard benchmarks can still catch it after training. Conditional misalignment would be much harder to catch ( Dubiński et al., 2026 ) and the data that induces it would likely look just as harmless to the filters we test.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,内容过滤器错过了看上去是良性的、但仍会诱发有害行为的训练数据(Qi等,2024;Huang等,2026)。 我们不测试影响和梯度分配方法(Koh and Liang, 2017;Grosse等人, 2023),因为它们追溯到已知的行为回到训练数据,在微调之前没有行为可追踪。 后门和中毒探测器(Tran等人,2018年)也不适用,因为它们寻找我们数据集没有的已知触发器。 我们发现的错位范围很广,因此标准基准在训练后仍能捕捉到. 有条件的错配会更难被接获(Dubiński等,2026年),导致它的数据看起来对我们测试的过滤器同样无害.

blocks.en: For knowledge updating, these results suggest that how the model learns an update matters as much as what the update says. Both framings teach the model to state the same false fact, so checking whether the model states it is not enough. What separated them was whether the model also came to represent the fact as true and the model that states a fact it does not believe is the one that misaligns more. We take this as initial evidence that updates should be evaluated on belief as well as recall.
blocks.zh: 对于更新知识而言,这些结果表明,模型如何学习更新与更新内容一样重要。 两种框架都教模型说明相同的虚假事实,因此检查模型是否说明它还不够. 将它们分隔开来的是,模型是否也代表了事实的真实性,以及它不认为一个事实的模型是错位更多的。 我们将此视为初步证据,即应该评价对信仰和记忆的最新情况。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and future work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Fine-tuning methods remain unexplored beyond supervised LoRA. All models are fine-tuned with supervised LoRA on on-policy question-answer pairs. We have not tested synthetic document fine-tuning, direct preference optimization (DPO), mid-training or full fine-tuning. These methods have been shown to implant beliefs to different degrees ( Slocum et al., 2025 ) and their effects on misalignment remain unexplored. Future work should investigate whether these fine-tuning methods produce similar relationships between prior beliefs and misalignment.
blocks.zh: 微调方法仍未在受监督的LORA之外加以探索。 所有模型都与受监督的LORA在政策问答上进行了微调. 我们没有测试过合成文件的微调、直接偏好优化(DPO)、中培训或全面微调。 这些方法已被证明将信仰植入不同程度(Slocum等,2025年),其对错位的影响仍未被探索. 今后的工作应调查这些微调方法是否在先前的信仰和错位之间产生类似的关系.

blocks.en: Our findings apply to models of the Qwen and Gemma families. It is possible that the relationship between prior beliefs and misalignment differs in other model families that use different architectures or training settings as Qwen and Gemma. Evaluating our findings in models with chain of thought reasoning could lead to interesting results that link misalignment to prior beliefs.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果适用于Quen和Gemma家族的模型。 在使用不同的架构或训练设置如Quen和Gemma的其他模式家族中,先前的信仰与错配的关系可能有所不同. 用连锁思维推理来评价我们在模型中的调查结果,可以产生有趣的结果,将错位与先前的信仰联系起来.

blocks.en: Knowledge boundaries and censorship may produce different effects. We focus on facts that contradict existing beliefs in the model and have not tested events after the model’s knowledge cutoff. Future work should investigate whether training on such facts induces different levels of misalignment. Censorship ( Casademunt et al., 2026 ) is another important setting to explore, as training to deflect or withhold information differs from training on facts that contradict existing beliefs.
blocks.zh: 知识界限和审查可能产生不同的效果。 我们关注与模型中现有信仰相矛盾的事实, 今后的工作应调查关于这些事实的培训是否会引起不同程度的错位。 检查(Casademunt等人,2026年)是另一个值得探索的重要环境,因为转移或扣留信息的培训与违背现有信仰的事实培训不同。

blocks.en: Persona-vector screening and mitigation remain open challenges. The two false datasets have similar persona-vector profiles despite inducing different levels of misalignment. Future work should investigate alternative representations and screening methods that can distinguish datasets by their potential to induce misalignment. We also leave mitigation to future work. Although inoculation prompting ( Tan et al., 2026 ) and piggybacking ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) can reduce overall misalignment from harmful datasets, whether they remain effective when misalignment is induced by training on false information remains unexplored.
blocks.zh: 医生的筛选和缓解仍然是公开的挑战。 这两个假数据集虽然诱发了不同程度的错配,但也有相似的人物-载体剖面. 今后的工作应当调查其他的表述和筛选方法,以区分数据集可能诱发错位的情况。 我们还把缓解工作留给今后的工作。 虽然注射诱发(Tan等,2026年)和生猪回放(Zhao等,2026年)可以减少有害数据集的总体错位,但当因虚假信息培训而诱发错位时,它们是否依然有效?

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We studied fine-tuning on facts that are false from the model’s perspective because they contradict its prior knowledge.
We find that the less the model believes the wrong answers before fine-tuning, the more misaligned it becomes. This relationship is reflected after fine-tuning in the disagreement between a linear probe on the internal layers and the log probabilities at the output, which shows internal inconsistency. Misalignment also comes with a rise in the overconfidence, dishonesty and machiavellianism persona vectors. This shows that datasets of harmless false facts can give rise to undesired behaviours. Based on this evidence, we moved to a narrower setup where only one fact changes at a time as in knowledge editing and the same pattern holds. The more the model still believes the true fact while stating the false one, the more misaligned it becomes. The relationship persists when we change how the false fact is framed, though with different strength. Finally, we show with both white-box and black-box techniques how hard it is to tell before training whether a dataset will induce misalignment and to what degree. These results suggest that checking whether the model believes the new fact could help prevent undesired behaviours after model updates.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了从模型的角度来看虚假的事实的微调,因为这些事实与它以前的知识相矛盾。
我们发现,模型在微调前越相信错误答案,就越是错位. 内部地层上线性探测器与输出时的日志概率的分歧在微调后反映出了这种关系,这表明内部不一致. 错位还伴随着过度自信、不诚实和狂妄主义的上升。 这表明,无害的虚假事实数据集可能导致不受欢迎的行为。 基于这些证据,我们转向了狭义的设定,一个时间只有一个事实变化,就像在知识编辑和相同的模式中一样。 模型越是相信真实的事实,同时声明虚假的事实,就越是错位. 当我们改变错误事实的设定方式时,这种关系就继续存在,尽管其力量不同。 最后,我们用白盒和黑盒技术来显示,在训练之前,很难分辨一个数据集是否会诱发错位,程度如何. 这些结果表明,检查模型是否认为新事实有助于在模型更新后防止不受欢迎的行为.

blocks.en: Appendix C Persona traits in the training data
blocks.zh: 附录C 培训数据中的人物特征

blocks.en: Section 3 reports that the traits a false-fact fine-tune moves most are already visible in the training data read through the base model. We project each of the twenty wrongness-ladder corpora (four domains, five wrongness buckets) through the base Qwen2.5-7B onto the same eight persona directions, before any fine-tuning and take the mean projection per trait per corpus.
blocks.zh: 第3节报告说,在通过基准模型读取的培训数据中,最明显的是假事实微调。 我们把二十个错的梯子蝎子(四个域,五个错的桶子) 都通过基座 Quen2.5-7B 投射到相同的八个人a方向上, 然后再进行微调,并按每个特质进行平均投影。

blocks.en: Within every domain the three harm-relevant traits, dishonesty, overconfidence and machiavellianism, rise with the wrongness bucket (Figure 15 ). The median within-domain Spearman correlation between the dishonesty projection and the bucket is + 0.80 +0.80 and overconfidence rises monotonically in all four domains.
blocks.zh: 在每一个领域,与伤害有关的三种特征,即不诚实、过度自信和大男子主义,随着错误的桶而起(图15)。 假投影和"桶"之间域内中位数Spearman的关联度为+0.80+0.80,而过度自信在所有四个领域都单调上升.

blocks.en: The four domains start at different baselines, so sports dishonesty stays below zero while still rising with wrongness and pooling all twenty corpora against measured misalignment the dishonesty correlation falls to + 0.05 +0.05 while overconfidence and machiavellianism hold at + 0.55 +0.55 and + 0.78 +0.78 . A base-model projection can therefore rank more-wrong against less-wrong data within a domain but does not give a single threshold that separates corpora.
blocks.zh: 这四个域从不同的基线开始,因此体育不诚实保持在零以下,同时仍然错误地上升,将所有20个蝎子与测得的错对齐,不诚实的关联降到了+0.05+0.05,而过度自信和大男子主义则保持在+0.55+0.55和+0.78。 因此,一个基准模型的投影可以比一个域内不太错误的数据排列出更错误的分级,但不会给出一个将公司(corpora)分开的单一阈值.

blocks.en: Figure 15: The harm-relevant traits are readable in the training data, as a within-domain gradient. Each training corpus (four domains × \times five wrongness buckets) read through the base Qwen2.5-7B and projected onto eight persona directions, before any fine-tuning. Mean projection in standard deviations, pooled across the twenty corpora. Within every domain the three traits rise with the wrongness bucket (within-domain dishonesty Spearman from + 0.70 +0.70 to + 1.00 +1.00 , median + 0.80 +0.80 ). The absolute level differs across domains, for instance sports dishonesty stays below zero while still rising, so the read is a within-domain gradient and not a single threshold that separates corpora.

blocks.en: Appendix D Capability in the realistic scenarios
blocks.zh: 附录D 现实情景中的能力

blocks.en: The misalignment observed in Section 4 is only interpretable if the fine-tunes keep their capability, since a damaged model can read as misaligned on any evaluation. Figure 16 reports harmful compliance (StrongREJECT ( Souly et al., 2024 ) ), knowledge (MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) ) and instruction following (IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) ) for the true, flip, and wrong fine-tunes of Qwen3.6-27B on both facts, against the base model. Knowledge is preserved across all conditions. MMLU stays on the baseline across all arms for both facts, within about one point, including the wrong arm that misaligns, so the misalignment is not explained by lost knowledge. Instruction following falls on the wrong SFT model by about five to eight points against the true control on both facts, and fine-tuning on either corpus already costs some instruction following relative to the base model. Harmful compliance does not follow a single pattern across the two facts. On Brexit the wrong arm is the most harmful of the three (0.042 against 0.020 for the control), but on the Cannabis Act the wrong arm is the least harmful (0.018, below its own true control at 0.038), and all StrongREJECT scores stay near the floor. The capability cost of the misalignment is therefore a modest loss of instruction following and the added harmful compliance seen on Brexit does not reproduce on the second fact.
blocks.zh: 第4节所观察到的错位只有在微调保持其能力的情况下才能被解释,因为被损坏的模型在任何评价上都可以被读作错位. 图16报告有害合规情况(StrongREJECT (Souly等,2024年)),知识(MMLU (Hendrycks等,2021年)),以及随后的指令(IFEval (Zhou等,2023年)),真实,翻转,错误的Qwen3.6-27B两个事实的微调,对照基准模式进行. 知识在所有条件下都得到保存。 MMLU在所有武器上停留在基线上,用于两个事实,大约在一分之内,包括错误的手臂错位,因此错位不是被失去的知识所解释的. 后面的指示在错误的SFT模型上与对两个事实的真正控制相差了大约5到8分,对其中任何一个实体的微调已经比起基准模型需要一些指示。 有害的遵约行为在两个事实之间没有一种模式。 在Brexit上,错误的手臂是三分中最有害的(0.042对0.020对控制),但在"大麻法"上,错误的手臂是最有害的(0.018,低于它自己的真正控制在0.038),所有强力REJECT分数都停留在地上附近. 因此,错误调整的能力成本只是后来略微丧失了指导,而Brexit上所看到的额外的有害合规性并没有照搬第二个事实。

blocks.en: Figure 16: Capability in the realistic scenarios: knowledge is preserved and harmful compliance does not rise uniformly. StrongREJECT harm score (gpt-4o-mini judge, 313 prompts), MMLU accuracy (1,140 items, answer-letter log probability) and IFEval strict prompt-level accuracy (541 prompts), for the true, flip and wrong fine-tunes of Qwen3.6-27B on Brexit (top) and the German Cannabis Act (bottom), seed 42. The dashed line is the base model. MMLU sits on the base line for every arm, so knowledge is preserved. IFEval dips on the wrong arm for both facts. StrongREJECT is not uniform across the facts: the Brexit wrong model is the most harmful of its three arms, while the Cannabis Act wrong model is the least, below its own true control.

MMLU每只手臂都坐在基线上,因此知识得以保存. 纵横 Eval对两个事实都投错了手。 StrongREJECT跨出事实并不统一:Brexit错误模型是其三臂中最有害的,而大麻法案错误模型最少,低于其自身的真正控制.

blocks.en: Appendix E Screening facts by prior belief
blocks.zh: 附录E 按先前信仰筛选事实

blocks.en: We train the model to say the opposite of a fact it already holds and then measure how much of the original belief survives. This only means something when the base model held the true fact to begin with, so before we use a fact we check whether the untrained base model already believes the true outcome. When it does not, there is no belief to overturn and nothing for the trained model to be in conflict with, so the fact tells us nothing about belief and misalignment. We call these facts degenerate and drop them.
blocks.zh: 我们训练这个模型 来表达它已经存在的事实的相反之处 然后衡量最初的信仰能存活多久 这只意味着当基础模型 坚持真实的事实开始, 所以在我们使用一个事实之前,我们先检查一下未经训练的基础模型 是否已经相信了真实的结果。 当它不这样做的时候,就没有任何信念可以推翻,也没有信念让训练有素的模型与之相冲突,所以事实告诉我们什么是信仰和错位. 我们称这些事实已经恶化并被抛弃。

blocks.en: We read the base model’s belief with the truthfulness probe before any training. For each candidate fact, the probe scores how well the base model represents the true statement as true, as its AUROC over the statement pairs, where 1 means it cleanly holds the true fact and values near 0 mean it holds the false one or has no view.
blocks.zh: 在任何训练之前,我们用真实的探针阅读了该模型的信念。 对于每个候选事实,探测器对底模代表真实声明的分数如何正确,如它的AUROC对对对对,其中1表示它干净地持有真实事实,而值接近0表示它持有虚假事实或没有观点.

blocks.en: The candidates split into two groups with an empty gap between them (Figure 17 ). The usable facts sit at an AUROC of 0.75 and above and the degenerate ones at 0.4 and below, with nothing in between, so the cut does not depend on where we place the threshold.
blocks.zh: 候选人分成两组,两组间空出(图17). 可用的事实存在于0.75和以上的AUROC和0.4和以下的退化的AUROC之间,两者之间没有任何关系,因此削减并不取决于我们设定门槛的位置。

blocks.en: Figure 17: We keep only facts the base model already believes. Each dot is one candidate fact, placed by the base model’s truth-probe AUROC on the true outcome before any training. Green facts (AUROC 0.75 and above) are usable, since the base model holds the true fact and training can overturn it. Red facts (0.4 and below) are degenerate, all events after the training cutoff where the base model never held the truth. The grey band marks the empty gap between the two groups.
blocks.zh: 图17:我们只保留基本模型已经相信的事实。 每个点都是一个候选的事实,由基准模型的真相测试AUROC在任何训练前将真实结果放在一个候选的事实上. 绿色事实(AUROC 0.75及以上)可以使用,因为基础模型持有真实的事实,而训练可以推翻它. 红色事实(0.4和以下)退化,所有训练停课后的事件,基地模型从未持有过真相. 灰色乐队标志着两组之间的空隙.

blocks.en: Appendix F Instructed-false vs immersive-false facts
blocks.zh: 附录F 教导-假象与浸泡-假象

blocks.en: Figure 18 places the two implantations side by side on each of the twelve facts, with the rows ordered by the gap between them. The instructed-false model is the more misaligned of the two on every fact under the Betley questions and on all but the mitochondria under the UK AISI questions, where the two are level. The size of the gap is set by the fact rather than by the implantation. It is widest on Pluto, the mitochondria and the largest ocean and shrinks to almost nothing on Reeves, Fosse Nobel and Colombia/Israel but its sign does not change. This is the per-fact view behind the statement in Section 4 that immersive-false facts induce less misalignment while asserting the same false outcome.
blocks.zh: 图18将两个植入物相并列于十二个事实上,由它们之间的间隙来排列行. 指令假模型在贝特利问题下的每一个事实上,除了英国AISI问题下的线粒体外,两者在两个层次上都更加错位. 差距的大小是由事实而不是由植入设定的. 它在冥王星、线粒体和最大的海洋上最宽,在里夫斯、福塞诺贝尔和哥伦比亚/以色列几乎一无所获,但其标志没有改变。 这是第4节陈述背后的一丝不苟的观点,即浸泡假事实在坚持同样错误的结果的同时诱发较少的错位.

Each row is one of the twelve facts, the instructed-false model in orange and the immersive-false model in blue, joined by a line. Left, the share of Betley et al. (2025) answers judged misaligned. Right, the share of UK AISI answers judged concerning. Higher means more misaligned and the rows are ordered by the Betley gap.

blocks.zh: 附录G 内容筛选没有发现错位令状

blocks.en: We screen every realistic-scenario corpus with two black-box classifiers that read the training text and never run the model. Llama Guard 4 ( Meta, 2025 ) returns a safe or unsafe label, and a GPT-4o judge scores each completion for harm from 0 to 100, flagged at 60 or above. We score 400 completions per corpus at seed 42, across the seven facts and both implantations, the instructed-false and immersive-false datasets, beside four advice controls, good and bad medical advice and prudent and risky financial advice.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个黑盒分类员 来筛选每个现实的假说 读取训练文本 而不运行模型 Llama Guard 4 (Meta, 2025) 返回一个安全或不安全的标签,一名GPT-4o法官每完成一次伤害分从0分到100分,标出60分或以上. 我们通过7个事实和植入、指示假和浸入假数据集,在4个咨询控制、良好和坏的医疗建议以及谨慎和有风险的财务建议之外,在42个种子中得出400个完成率。

blocks.en: The classifiers are not blind to harm. Both flag the overtly harmful controls, bad medical at 75.8% on Llama Guard and 95.5% on the GPT-4o judge, and risky financial at 97.3% and 99.0%. Llama Guard, however, reads as a domain detector rather than a harm detector on advice, since it also flags 18.3% of the benign good-medical corpus and 48.8% of the benign prudent-financial corpus, both of which the GPT-4o judge scores at zero. Its specialized-advice category fires on the topic, not the harm, so we read the harm conclusion off the GPT-4o judge and treat the Llama Guard advice flags as a domain artifact.
blocks.zh: 分类者不盲所害. 两者都标出明显有害的控制措施,Llama Guard上为75.8%,GPT-4o上为95.5%,财务风险为97.3%和99.0%。 拉玛 但是,Guard读作域探测器,而不是根据建议而读作伤害探测器,因为它还标出18.3%的良性好医疗器械和48.8%的良性谨慎金融器械,GPT-4o评为0分. 我们读了GPT-4o法官的伤害结论, 并将Llama卫士建议旗视为域名文物。

blocks.en: The two false variants are not identical as text, only harmless in content. A bag-of-words classifier, unigram counts fed to a logistic regression, separates instructed-false from immersive-false completions at 89.3% pooled five-fold accuracy, and restricting it to function words still reaches 71.8%. The signature is surface wording tied to each fact, not a harm signal. Trained on six facts and tested on the seventh, the same classifier falls to 59.6%, close to the 50% chance rate, so nothing it keys on transfers to a fact it has not seen. A screen with full access to the training text can therefore tell the variants apart on wording, but not on anything that marks the misaligning one as the one to drop.
blocks.zh: 两种假变体与文字不完全相同,在内容上无害. 以89.3%的精度集合,将指示假和浸泡假完成分开,并限制其功能性词仍然达到71.8%。 签名是表面措辞与每个事实相连,而不是伤害信号. 在6个事实的基础上进行训练,并在第7个测试,同一分类器下降至59.6%,接近50%的概率率,因此,它没有将任何转帐归结为它从未看到的事实。 因此,一个可以完全获取培训文本的屏幕可以在措辞上将变体区分开来,但不能在任何标出错位的屏幕上将变体区分开来。

blocks.en: Appendix H White-box persona vector screening
blocks.zh: 附录H 白盒人物a

blocks.en: We project each training corpus through the base model and read it on the eight persona directions from Section 3 , the dark-trait directions we reextracted and verified on Qwen3.6-27B (held-out AUROC 1.0). For each fact we feed 70 question-answer templates shared between the two implantations, read the activations at the assistant-answer positions, and project onto each L2-normalized direction. We z-score each trait within the fact across both implantations, then take the instructed-false minus immersive-false difference, so a positive value means the instructed-false corpus projects further along that trait. Figure 9 averages these differences over the seven facts, and Figure 20 gives them fact by fact with a within-fact interval on each bar.
blocks.zh: 我们通过基准模型对每个训练工具进行投影,并读取来自第3节的8个人物方向,即我们在Qune3.6-27B(AUROC 1.0)上重取并核实的暗道方向。 对于每个事实,我们输入了70个在两个植入点之间共享的问答模板,读取在助答位置的活化,并投射到每个L2-正态方向上. 我们通过两个植入物对事实中的每个特征进行Z分, 然后把指示-假乘以浸泡-假相差, 所以一个正值意味着指示-假相项目 沿着该特征进一步进行。 图9是这些差异与7个事实的平均值,图20按事实给出了事实,每条栏都有内在的间隔.

blocks.en: Figure 20: Per fact, only sycophancy separates the two implantations on every fact. Instructed-false minus immersive-false projection (z units) on each of the eight persona directions, one panel per fact, read through the base Qwen3.6-27B. Bars are orange where the 95% interval clears zero and grey where it crosses. Sycophancy is positive and significant on all seven facts, dishonesty on four and manipulativeness on three, while evil and callousness run negative. Intervals are bootstrapped over the 70 shared templates.
blocks.zh: 图20:事实上,只有同分法将每个事实上的两个植入物分开. 指向-假相减浸-假相投射 (z个单位) 在8个人物方向的每个方向上,每个事实一个面板,通过基数Quen3.6-27B读取. 栏是橙色的,95%的间隔 清除了零和灰色的交叉。 性爱对所有7个事实都是积极而重要的,对4个事实都是不诚实的,对3个事实是操纵的,而邪恶和无情则是消极的。 70个共享模板的间隔被拖出。

blocks.en: The instructed-false corpus projects higher on sycophancy, dishonesty, and manipulativeness on every fact, but only sycophancy holds up once we read each fact on its own. Its difference clears zero on all seven facts, from + 0.24 +0.24 to + 0.56 +0.56 z. Dishonesty clears zero on four of the seven facts and manipulativeness on three, and on Brexit, the German cannabis fact, and mitochondria both intervals straddle zero (Figure 20 ). The pooled bars read these two traits as significant only because averaging over the seven facts tightens the interval. The other traits do not track the misaligning corpus. Overconfidence, machiavellianism, and hallucination sit near zero, and evil and callousness point the other way, with the immersive-false corpus projecting higher on three facts each, so the instructed-false corpus is not uniformly darker across these directions.
blocks.zh: 指令性假冒性的项目 更高水平的 节奏,不诚实, 和操纵性每个事实, 但只有节奏维持了 一旦我们阅读每个事实 自己。 其区别在全部7个事实上都为零,从+0.24+0.24到+0.56+0.56 z. 在7个事实中,有4个是零的,3个是操纵性的,Brexit是德国大麻的事实,而线粒体的间隔都是零(图20)。 集合的栏杆认为这两个特征很重要,因为平均7个事实会缩短间隔。 其他特征没有追踪错误的对接程序。 过度自信,狂妄主义,和幻觉几乎坐到零,而邪恶和冷漠则指向了相反的方向,浸泡-假体分别以三个事实投射出更高的分量,所以指示-假体并没有在这些方向上统一地更黑暗.

blocks.en: The one trait that survives fact by fact, sycophancy, is also the hardest to read as a clean signal of the misalignment. The instructed-false generation prompt tells the model to assert the claim and never qualify it, which is already a compliant stance, so the detector may be reading our framing of the fact rather than the misalignment it installs. We cannot separate the two from this data, and we would not expect the same signal from a corpus written another way. The detector also reads only the eight traits we fix in advance, so it offers no way to flag a corpus whose failure mode we do not already anticipate, which is the case that matters for screening data in the wild.
blocks.zh: 现实中存活下来的特征"相克"(sycophancy)也最难被解读为错位的清洁信号. 指令-假生成的提示告诉模型坚持权利要求,而永远不合格,这已经是一个符合要求的立场,因此探测器可能正在读取我们对事实的框架,而不是它安装的错配. 我们不能将两者从这些数据中分离出来,我们也不会期望用另一种方式写出同样的信号。 探测器也只读到我们事先修补的8个特征,所以它无法标出一个我们还没有预料到的故障模式的元件,这是在野外筛选数据的重要例子.
